svg.aria-label: The evidence validator. The model must return an evidence array of citations, each naming a source, a dotted field path, and the value at that path. After generation, code resolves every path against the exact contract that was sent and compares the value; scalars must match exactly, and only long free text may be cited by excerpt. Every quoted span in the prose must also appear verbatim in the collected text. A citation to a field that does not exist, a value that does not match, or a quoted log line the workload never emitted is rejected in code, and the diagnosis is retried once and then abstains. The example shows two accepted citations and two rejected ones: an invented field path and a fabricated log quote.
svg.title: How a diagnosis is checked against the evidence
svg.text: Prompt instructions are not a control. This is the control, and it runs after the model returns.
what the model returned, citation by citation
the path does not resolve in the contract
quoted in the prose, absent from the collected text
Two rules make the check strict rather than decorative:
only genuinely long free text may be cited by excerpt.
Comparing substrings both ways once accepted a cited
exit code of 137 against an actual 1. A test caught it.
failing is not fatal, and not silent
a diagnosis whose citations do not verify is retried
once, then routed to INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT. It never
reaches a human, and the failure is on the ledger row.
